# #3308: CI: daily super run failed
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

[super run 42238953974](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42238953974) on `staging` (`053ba7e`, workflow_dispatch) failed:

| Job | Result |
|---|---|
| [e2e component (chrome)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42238953974/job/127966606331) | failure |
| [e2e (6/8)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42238953974/job/127971536274) | failure |
| [fuzz (3/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42238953974/job/127971536465) | failure |

Each link opens that job's log. This issue stays open while the run is red and the next run that passes every job closes it. `gh workflow run super.yml --ref <branch>` runs it again on demand.

Night bot: this run is on `staging`, so it is yours, and it comes first (`priority:high`, and you take it before every other queued item): production promotes itself only from a daily run on `staging` that passes every job, so it waits on this fix. The fix lands on `main` like any other, and promote-staging.yml brings it to `staging` within two hours; the next daily run there that passes promotes it, or a `/promote` on the production issue tests staging's newer commit sooner. Root-cause each failed job from its log and fix it in a pull request: a flake is not a root cause, so make a flaky test robust instead of re-running it, and never skip, disable or quarantine a test to get green. Reproduce it with the job's own command (CLAUDE.md, Commands; one fuzz seed is `cargo jackioh fuzz --from <seed> --seeds 1`, with `--handicap` for the handicapped wave and `--duos` for the Duos wave; a daily test is `cargo test -p <crate> <name> -- --ignored`). A pull request's CI runs only the e2e smoke specs and leaves the tests marked `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` out, so say in the pull request which job here the fix makes pass and how you checked it. You cannot change `.github/`: make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, and when the rest needs a workflow or an action, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them.

---
_Posted by `.github/workflows/super.yml`._

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-6` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42264228771)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Make the three failed jobs of super run 42238953974 pass, each by fixing its root cause and not by skipping or loosening a check:

- **`fuzz (3/4)`**: the handicapped wave's seed 7089 fails the I2 "extra attack" invariant. The engine is right and the test monitor is wrong.
- **`e2e (6/8)`**: specs 07 and 17 fail on stale test inputs.
- **`e2e component (chrome)`**: `card-faces.cy.tsx` and `deckbuilder-layout.cy.tsx` fail.

I could not read the job logs, because the bot has no GitHub access. Every failure below was reproduced locally at base `ffa18b45f7`, and the fixes were checked at `e60a0f0b08` (current `main`), with the commands listed under **Tests**. The pull request must say which job each fix makes pass and how it was checked.

## Files to touch

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` | `note_drawn_windfury` gains a `back_later` argument; its `Summoned` call site computes it. |
| `crates/cards/tests/cross/invariants.rs` | Two new tests, beside `r636_a_keyword_drawing_token_gone_by_the_action_s_end_may_have_attacked_twice`. |
| `e2e/cypress/component/card-faces.cy.tsx` | Move two collection-time face-model calls into `before` hooks. |
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/workshop.css` | Phone block: make the `.portrait-current { padding: 0 }` rule take effect. |
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/deckbuilder.css` | `@media (max-width: 760px)` block: `.db-header` padding and `.db-layout` gap, both as spacing tokens. |
| `e2e/cypress/e2e/07-my-pawn-ai.cy.ts` | `GRINDERS` table: Pointmaster's attack 7 becomes 6. |
| `e2e/fixtures/decks/17-live-a.json` | Handicap `manaBonus` 0 becomes 1, and the description is updated. |

Do not touch:
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` and `.claude/`.
- `spec/`: no ruling is needed, because [[R636]] and R781004 already govern the monitor, and no rule is decided.
- Any engine, cards or AI code outside the `testkit` monitor.
- The 844 assertion in `deckbuilder-layout.cy.tsx`, spec 30, `spacing.test.ts` and its counts, and `top-bar.test.ts`.

## Steps

1. **Fix the monitor** in `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`.

   *Cause.* Seed 7089's single `attack` action auto-ends the turn. Stinkyscape #47's autopilot aura then plays p2's turn 12 and p1's turn 13 inside one `reduce` call. A Drone Corvette c77 (a token that draws random combat keywords) attacks twice with Windfury, which the engine rightly allows. It is destroyed, then re-summoned with `via: Reborn` under the same id and a fresh draw. The monitor reads Windfury only off the final state, so it sees the new stint and flags the old stint's second attack.

   *Edits.*
   - Change the signature to `fn note_drawn_windfury(&mut self, id: &str, def_id: &str, state: &GameState, back_later: bool)`.
   - Replace its first arm, `Some(card) if card.zone.z() == ZoneName::Field => false,`, with:
     ```rust
     // On the field at the action's end its keywords are read there (`note_entry_windfury`), unless it
     // came back later in this action (Reborn) with a draw of its own, which says nothing of the stint
     // it ended (fuzz seed 7089, handicapped).
     Some(card) if card.zone.z() == ZoneName::Field => {
         back_later && crate::scripts::script_of(state, card).conditional_keywords.is_some()
     }
     ```
   - Extend its doc comment with: "So does one that is back on the field by the end as a new stint (`back_later`: it re-entered later in the action's events, Reborn), whose new draw says nothing of the stint before it (the Drone Corvette, seed 7089)."
   - In `Monitor::after`, in the `Summoned` arm (the one with `self.enter(instance_id)`), replace the call with:
     ```rust
     let back_later = events.get(index + 1..).unwrap_or_default().iter().any(|later| {
         matches!(later, GameEvent::Summoned { instance_id: again, .. } if again == instance_id)
     });
     self.note_drawn_windfury(instance_id, def_id, state, back_later);
     ```
   - The other call, in the `Fused` arm (`result_instance_id`), passes `false`.
   - Run `cargo fmt`. Do not hand-format.

2. **Add the two tests** to `crates/cards/tests/cross/invariants.rs`, placed just before the doc comment "R12, R636: a steal keeps a card on the field…". Both go in the same module as that neighbour, which already has `scenario`, `event`, `find_instance_mut` and `no_violations` in scope.
   - `r636_a_keyword_drawing_token_back_by_reborn_inside_the_action_may_have_attacked_twice`:
     - Build `scenario(json!({ "p1": { "field": [{ "def": "stinkyscape-t-drone-corvette", "lane": 1 }] } }))`.
     - Take `back = g.unit_at(PlayerId::P1, 1).id`.
     - Set `summoned_turn = Some(g.state().turn)` through `find_instance_mut`, as `r636_a_windfury_unit_made_inside_the_action_is_read_where_the_action_left_it` does. Without this the monitor reports an unrelated I4 finding.
     - Create the monitor, then assert that `monitor.after(&[summoned(None), declared(), declared(), summoned(Some("Reborn"))], g.state())` equals `no_violations()`.
     - `summoned(via)` is `event(json!({"type":"summoned","player":"p1","instanceId":back,"defId":DRONE_CORVETTE,"row":"units","lane":1,"via":via}))`.
     - `declared()` is `event(json!({"type":"attackDeclared","attackerId":back,"targetId":"hero-p2","forced":false}))`.
   - `r636_a_unit_with_no_drawn_keywords_back_by_reborn_inside_the_action_still_attacked_twice_too_many` (the control):
     - The same shape with `VANILLA` (`"core-008"`, the file's constant).
     - Assert exactly one finding, and that it contains `"I2 extra attack"`.
   - The first test fails without step 1, with the same message the fuzz printed. Both pass with it.

3. **Fix `card-faces.cy.tsx`.** Two statements run while Cypress collects the file. That is before `e2e/support/component.tsx`'s root `before(loadWasm)`, so the engine is not loaded and the whole spec dies with "the engine is not loaded: await loadWasm() before calling face".
   - In `describe("R1017002: …")`, replace `const FAN_DEFS = rotationPool(true);` with:
     ```tsx
     let FAN_DEFS: readonly CardDef[] = [];
     before(() => {
       FAN_DEFS = rotationPool(true);
     });
     ```
   - In `describe("faces in play fit their boxes (SPEC §10.10)")`, change `const ENTRIES: readonly Entry[] = [ … ];` to `let ENTRIES: readonly Entry[] = [];` followed by `before(() => { ENTRIES = [ …same elements, unchanged… ]; });`. Leave `fusedPair`, `crafted` and `heroic` where they are, since they are plain data.
   - Add a one-line comment on each: "worked out through the face model, so only once the module is loaded".

4. **Fix the deck builder's phone layout.**

   *Cause.* #3243 (#3218) put BackLink's two-row top bar on phones, which grew `.db-header` from 85 to 110 px. The first pool row's bottom went from 838 to 863, and the spec wants at most 844. Reverting #3243 made the spec pass.

   *Edits.* Take 19 px back without touching the bar:
   - `workshop.css`, phone block (`@media (max-width: 760px)`, the rule just under `.ws-name`): change the selector `.portrait-current` to `.deckbuilder.app-shell .portrait-current`, keeping `padding: 0;`. The existing rule loses to `.app-shell button` (8px 16px) and left the picker 62 px tall. This saves 13 px.
   - `deckbuilder.css`, in the `@media (max-width: 760px)` block commented "Phone and narrow tablet: one column, the sidebar first", add as its first rule:
     ```css
     .db-header {
       padding: 0 var(--space-1) var(--space-2);
     }
     ```
     This saves 8 px.
   - In the same block's `.db-layout` rule, add `gap: var(--space-5);` (it was 14 px). This saves 4 px.
   - Use tokens: `spacing.test.ts` counts raw `px` lengths per sheet (`deckbuilder.css` 86, `workshop.css` 87), and none may gain one.
   - Expected first-row bottom is about 838 px, the pre-#3243 value. It measured 842 with the first two edits.

5. **Fix spec 07.** In `GRINDERS`, change `{ defId: catalogId(20), name: nameOf(20), attack: 7, cost: 2 }` to `attack: 6`. SPEC §8 row 20 (`spec/08-catalog.md`) is Pointmaster 6/1 since #3136; the spec's number was stale. The failure was hero health 24 against an expected 23.

6. **Fix spec 17.**

   *Cause.* KY's Trial costs 2 since #3136, but the fixture promised "the 1 mana KY's Trial costs". Player 1 cannot cast it on turn 1, so no `[data-prompt-kind="discover"]` ever appears.

   *Edit.* In `e2e/fixtures/decks/17-live-a.json`, set the handicap's `"manaBonus": 1` (fixtures 25, 32 and 43 already use it; mana is `turns_started + manaBonus`, capped by `manaCap` 4, and uses no randomness, so the deal is unchanged). Rewrite the description's last sentences to say that KY's Trial costs 2 since #3136, so the handicap is TUTORIAL_HUMAN's with a `manaBonus` of 1 that makes turn 1 a 2-mana turn.

## Tests

- **Cards crate:** `cargo fmt --check`, then `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards r636_`. The two new tests are among the 15 passing.
- **Engine and lints:**
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test rules windfury`
  - `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`
  - `cargo jackioh spec check`
- **Fuzz:**
  - `cargo jackioh fuzz --from 7089 --seeds 1 --handicap` must print "1 passed, 0 failed". Before the fix it printed the I2 finding.
  - Optionally rerun the `fuzz (3/4)` waves. At base, plain 5001–7500 and Duos 1001–1500 passed, and the handicapped wave 5001–7500 failed only on seed 7089.
- **Web unit tests:** `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/spacing.test.ts src/routes/top-bar.test.ts src/palette.test.ts src/surfaces.test.ts src/typography.test.ts src/motion.test.ts` (48 pass).
- **Component specs** (needs `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`, Chrome): `CI=true pnpm --dir e2e exec cypress run --component --browser chrome --spec cypress/component/card-faces.cy.tsx,cypress/component/deckbuilder-layout.cy.tsx`.
  - `card-faces` runs 26 tests. Before the fix none ran.
  - `deckbuilder-layout` runs 21.
  - The other 39 component specs already passed at base.
- **e2e shard 6.** Build `cargo build --release -p jackioh-server -p jackioh-tools`, `pnpm build:e2e` and `pnpm --dir apps/admin build:e2e`. Then:
  1. Start `E2E=1 pnpm --dir apps/web exec vite preview --port 5173 --strictPort`.
  2. Start `E2E=1 pnpm --dir apps/admin exec vite preview`.
  3. Start `CATALOG_VERSION=$(target/release/jackioh catalog-version) E2E=1 target/release/jackioh-server`.
  4. Run `cd e2e && E2E=1 pnpm exec cypress run --browser chrome --spec cypress/e2e/07-my-pawn-ai.cy.ts,cypress/e2e/17-card-showcase-and-hovers.cy.ts,cypress/e2e/30-activate.cy.ts`.

  Spec 30 reads `<repo>/target/release/jackioh`. If `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` points elsewhere, symlink the binary into `target/release/` and delete the link afterwards. It passes at base once the binary exists, so only 07 and 17 were red.
- **e2e against the CSS change** (served from a client built with `vite build --mode development`): specs 47 (30 tests), 46 (54), 09 (6) and 18 (5) all passed.

## Done when

- [ ] Seed 7089 handicapped passes, and both new `r636_` tests are in the cards crate.
- [ ] `card-faces` (26) and `deckbuilder-layout` (21) pass unchanged except for the edits above.
- [ ] Specs 07, 17 and 30 pass; specs 46 and 47 still pass.
- [ ] The pull request names each of the three jobs and how it was checked.
- [ ] No test was skipped, ignored or loosened.
- [ ] The harness checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests (no `apps/web/src/wire` diff) and web tests.

## Risks

- **The monitor is more lenient in one narrow case.** I2 now excuses a unit whose script draws keywords (`conditional_keywords`) and re-enters within the same action. A plain unit is still flagged, which the control test proves. The change is `testkit`-only, so it cannot alter engine behaviour, replay or hashes. The Duos monitor wraps the same code.
- **The CSS edits are for the phone deck builder only.** They sit inside `max-width: 760px` blocks and use tokens, so `spacing.test.ts` counts are unchanged. Do not add `.screen-nav__…` selectors, which `top-bar.test.ts` forbids.
- **The wall-clock limit is untouched.** My Duos wave reported a slowest checkpoint of 4464 ms against the 5000 ms bound (`CHECKPOINT_TIME_BOUND_MS`, `fuzz.rs` and `duos_fuzz.rs`) while the machine was loaded. It passed and is not the cause here. If a later run fails with "checkpoint took …ms", look there.
- **There is no fuzz-corpus record.** `crates/tools/fuzz-corpus/README.md` says the handicapped and Duos waves have no corpus, so the unit tests are the regression proof.

## Open questions

None block the work. No change is needed under `.github/`. One thing a person may want to know: I could not read the CI logs, so the mapping from each job to its cause comes from local reproduction (the logs themselves were not checked).
